text: After the funeral of her secretive mother Ellen, Annie Graham, who builds miniature rooms in her Utah home, watches grief settle over her family. Her withdrawn daughter Charlie [cuts the head off a dead bird|images|animals and birds], Ellen's grave is vandalised, and a terrible road accident turns mourning into blame between Annie and her son Peter. A kindly woman from a support group teaches her [a séance to reach the dead|trigger|calling on unseen powers], and Ellen's belongings begin to reveal [what she left the family|origin|family blood and inheritance], and [a demon king who wants a male host|wants|a way into life].
